report.explanation: All eight telemetry reads returned SNAPSHOT_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; tool failures are missing evidence, not proof of a fault. No current observation establishes any bounded root cause, so no candidate is asserted and the incident is handed off pending restored read-only telemetry.
missing_evidence: Read-only telemetry for gateway, order, payment, inventory (metrics, logs, traces) is unavailable; need successful reads to identify any fault.
No service-level facts or deployment records available to bound a candidate cause.
Need confirmation of which checkout component is degraded and its error signature.
